question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the following description.

"A person who talks excessively"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Garulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garulous"** refers to a person who talks excessively or unnecessarily, especially about trivial matters. (बातूनी)

 
 
• **Example:** The old man was so garulous that he kept talking for hours about his childhood memories.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Garulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Silent** (चुप): Someone who does not speak or is quiet.

 
 
• **Example:** The room was silent as everyone awaited the announcement.
 
 
 
• **Introvert** (अंतर्मुखी): A person who prefers solitude and avoids social interactions.
 
 
• **Example:** Being an introvert, he finds peace in spending time alone.
 
 
 
• **Reticent** (अल्पभाषी): Someone who is not inclined to speak or express themselves freely.
 
 
• **Example:** She was reticent about her plans for the weekend.
